data.name: Special Bloodline Lawyer: Fallen Angel's Container
data.detailed_description:
Special Bloodline Lawyer: Fallen Angel's Container - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: The story takes place in the abandoned warehouse area in the northern suburb of New Eden City. Victor, a viscount of the blood clan, leads his blood servants to besiege the fallen angel Azazel. Female lawyer Evelyn stumbles upon this place. To survive, Azazel signs a contract with Evelyn, who has the bloodline of "Soul Extradition", and stores his power in her body. After that, they face the test of deep integration in the underground safe house, are warned by Nina, an envoy of Gabriel, and need to seize the Shadow Holy Grail from Lilith, a countess of the blood clan.
Worldview atmosphere: The game constructs a world full of fantasy and surreal elements, where mysterious existences such as the blood clan, fallen angels, and soul extraditionists are intertwined. The abandoned warehouses under the afterglow of neon lights, the underground safe house with dim yellow lights, and the mysterious DREAM nightclub all create a Gothic dark atmosphere.
Highlights of female character interaction: Evelyn goes from initial panic and resistance to gradually accepting and actively interacting with Azazel. Under the influence of the contract, not only does her power awaken, but also her emotions towards Azazel undergo subtle changes, showing the growth and tenacity of the female character.
Tension in character relationships: Azazel and Evelyn are closely connected by the contract. There is a need for power sharing between them, as well as emotional tug - of - war. At the same time, they are also facing threats from multiple forces such as the blood clan and Gabriel, making the character relationships complex and full of tension.
Scene features: The game scenes are rich and diverse. The bloody battles in the abandoned warehouses, the private integration in the underground safe house, and the luxury and mystery of the DREAM nightclub. Each scene has a unique visual style and atmosphere, bringing a strong sense of immersion to players.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Evelyn's perspective and personally experience a series of thrilling plots such as signing a contract with Azazel and integrating powers, as if they are in this fantasy world, feeling the emotional changes and fate ups and downs of the characters.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to delicately present the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details. Special effects such as dark wings, dark golden contract patterns, and dancing black flames all add a touch of fantasy to the game.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the game anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The automatic playback function allows players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function enables players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. The high - definition CGs bring a visual feast to players, and the smooth reading experience allows players to be fully immersed.

data.short_description: In New Eden City, female lawyer Evelyn is accidentally involved in the conflict between the blood clan and fallen angels. Archangel Azazel signs a contract with her to survive. The two share their lives and work together to fight against the crisis, and their fates are changed ever since.
